$comment: Extra clips for experiments (not part of the official benchmark). Built like fleurs-nl in clips.json: FLEURS test split, rows from 0, the smallest count that reaches 180 s (nl_nl gives 18 by this rule), 0.5 s gaps, CC BY 4.0. The datasets server cannot serve these configs, so fetch.mjs reads the same rows from the raw archive ("archive": true; checked to give byte-identical audio for nl_nl). Fetch with: node bench/fetch.mjs --clips bench/clips.extra.json (checksums in bench/checksums.extra.json).

clips.context: German read speech: unrelated sentences from news and encyclopedia articles.
